notes.title: Welcome to play "Adventures of Ruby Rabbit" (・ェ・. )~~~
notes.content:
Demo

Hello, I'm 冰丶羽。

Ruby Rabbit's Adventure has participated in Steam's June Next Fest and will release a demo version for everyone to play.

The current demo version is less complete. It may need more optimization, and I will continue to update it in the future.
I hope you can give effective feedback after the experience. Help me improve the game better;

If you like this game, don't forget to add it to your wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1205570



Unfinished development

There are still many aspects that may not be officially developed yet, and will be continuously improved in subsequent versions:

Optimization of the data, I haven't made many adjustments in terms of the data, which can lead to a bad experience for you.
Archive and online, currently archive is not compatible with the official version. In terms of online games, I still need to optimize it in the future.
The UI support of the controller has not yet been developed, and I will improve it in the future.
Other unfinished sections.
